{"cut_point":"We are given the following:

- There are two types of boxes:
  - One holds **20 parts**.
  - The other holds **27 parts**.
- A batch of parts is between **500 and 600**.
- When packed into the **first type of box (20 parts)**, **13 parts are left unpacked**.
- When packed into the **second type of box (27 parts)**, **7 spots are left unfilled** (i.e., 7 parts are left unpacked).","reflection":{"verified_state":["The batch size N is between 500 and 600 inclusive.","Packing into 20-part boxes leaves 13 parts, so N ≡ 13 (mod 20).","The 27-part box condition is that 7 spots are left unfilled."],"error_step":"(i.e., 7 parts are left unpacked)","error_reason":"This equates unfilled spots with unpacked parts, but if a 27-part box has 7 unfilled spots, it contains 20 parts and no parts are left unpacked. Therefore the second condition should be N ≡ 20 (mod 27), not N ≡ 7 (mod 27).","new_direction":"Set the second congruence to N ≡ 20 (mod 27) and solve it with N ≡ 13 (mod 20) in the range 500 to 600."}}
